I'm a small business owner/supporter of local businesses here in Seattle. The idea of a $15 minimum wage, while framed around "income inequality," really terrifies me for my livelihood and the livelihoods of my neighbors. I've heard the arguments, but they haven't swayed my fundamental opposition.

I strongly believe that small businesses need flexibility, and forcing a huge wage hike like this will destroy them, leading to layoffs and reduced services, even if it sounds nice on paper.

I'm going to reinforce my core beliefs about small business survival and service redesign, which are the most immediate threats this policy poses. The other arguments, like income inequality, are too abstract to move me from my strong opposition.

I will reinforce C_06 and C_09.
